findings.title: BYOD CREW TORCHES NASHVILLE CAMPUS
findings.comment: Files renamed to .byod, Box folders deleted, and the uni's own answer was "please turn your laptop off" — top-tier incident response, matey.

findings.title: QUEENS LIBRARY STILL CAN'T FIND ITS OWN CARD CATALOG
findings.comment: A week on, 2.3 million patrons still can't check out a book while the crew that did it hides behind total anonymity — bold strategy for a library with late fees waived as its only victory.

findings.title: RUSSIAN HOSTING GIANT WIPED DOWN TO THE KEEL
findings.comment: A wiper hit the management plane and erased VPS backups for 200,000+ customers — turns out sanctioning a host doesn't stop someone from sinking it outright first.

findings.title: N0N CLAIMS 19 MILLION IDENTITY RECORDS
findings.comment: A data broker allegedly robbed of the identities it was built to broker — delicious, if N0n weren't already flagged by researchers as a crew that makes up half its own victim list.

findings.title: N0N ROLLS THE DICE ON A SPORTSBOOK
findings.comment: Same shady crew, same day, now claiming a betting giant — place yer wager on whether this one's real or just chum for headlines.

findings.title: VORTEX SPINS UP A HEALTHCARE SHAKEDOWN
findings.comment: A leak-site clock ticking down with no proof of what was taken — Vortex gives a deadline but not a shred of the goods, classic extortion theater.

findings.title: BINANCE LISTING: 335M USERS FOR $900K
findings.comment: A ShinyHunters-branded seller on a freshly spawned underground forum demands $900k for "335M Binance users" — private keys included, keys Binance never holds. Even the forum regulars smell shark oil.

findings.title: REMUS STEALER SELLS GMAIL INBOX ACCESS
findings.comment: Stealer-as-a-service now ships a $1,000-a-month Enterprise tier with an inbox viewer reading victims' Gmail, codes and all — claimin' it survives password changes, though Hudson Rock found more tall tale than proof below decks.

findings.title: HOTMAIL COMBOLIST HAWKED ON NIFLHEIM.WORLD
findings.comment: PandaCloud's "Fresh HOTMAIL/MIX HITS" ad offers mail:pass combos with no samples, no counts, no prices — the real catch is your Telegram handle, where the negotiation fleecing begins.

findings.title: 95K MAILBOXES GATED BEHIND 2-CREDIT PAYWALL
findings.comment: Level-29 forum vet MegaCloud locks "95K Full Valid Mail Acccess" behind a two-credit toll with nary a sample shown — NulledBB's paywall works harder than the vendor's verification ever did.

findings.title: SAUDI BRIDGE FIRM LISTED WITH SCANNED IDS
findings.comment: Extortion broker DBHunter lists Cleveland Bridge with government ID scans in the hold — 54 listings in 30 days and not one proof file among them. Quantity over quality on the extortion quay, matey.

findings.title: SOCIAL-LOGIN WALLET KEYS EXTRACTED, $6M DRAINED
findings.comment: Sign in with Google, hand over the keys to the kingdom: bots pulled private keys from Web3Auth Keplr wallets and siphoned $6M through 2,520 sponsored drains. Convenience carved a fine plank for walkers.

findings.title: OPENSSH AUTH BYPASS MASS-EXPLOITED ON MUSL FLEETS
findings.comment: Alpine boxes with asterisk password fields be felled by an oversized password; KEV'd Nov 9 after root keys and cloud metadata were hauled off — upgrade to 10.6p2 or disable password auth, ye swabs.

findings.title: WORSE_QUERY SANDBOX ESCAPE UNPATCHED WHILE TOOLS SHIP
findings.comment: PoC dropped Nov 8, derivative file-manager plunder tools already out, and Apple's Nov 9 iOS updates fixed everything but this — mind yer sideloaded apps and wallet keys, ye gulls.

findings.title: GPUSTACK ADMIN BYPASS CONFIRMED EXPLOITED, FED DEADLINE NOV 12
findings.comment: One forged X-GPUStack-Real-IP header makes ye admin of the AI GPU fleet, reverse shells already confirmed on workers — upgrade to 2.2.2, hunt rogue API keys, and rotate every token, ye bilge rats.

findings.title: FRANCE BLAMES IRAN'S SHAHID KAVEH FOR MASS FRIDGE SABOTAGE
findings.comment: Paris formally pinned the October burnings of 700-plus supermarket cold rooms on an IRGC cyber unit — Ye ruined the frozen peas and now the crown wants yer head, matey.

findings.title: SLEEPYDUCK BACKDOORS BEE-JS VIA HIJACKED TRUSTED PUBLISHING
findings.comment: The scoundrels rode stolen GitHub identities through a legit OIDC pipeline so the provenance looked shipshape — aye, yer SLSA attestation be genuine treasure marked by the thief.

findings.title: BLIND EAGLE LURES LATIN AMERICA WITH FAKE COURT NOTICES
findings.comment: 3,300 phishing missives dressed as Colombian prosecutors delivered an AsyncRAT fork — the magistrate be a pirate in a powdered wig, and no confirmed victim took the bait yet.

findings.title: INC RANSOM FLOODS LEAK SITES WITH 88 VICTIMS IN A DAY
findings.comment: Forty-seven postings in one watch, plundering hospitals, clinics, and Beaver County — INC be hoarding victims like a dragon on a dubious treasure pile, and none of it verified.

findings.title: NVIDIA BOARD PROBES FOREIGN SPIES TARGETING JENSEN HUANG
findings.comment: The board swears no secrets were lost while it reviews foreign-intel courtship of its captain — no named culprit, no evidence shown, just a very nervous parrot in the boardroom.

findings.title: FOUR ACTIVELY EXPLOITED FLAWS ADDED
findings.comment: GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, OpenSSH and IBM Aspera joined KEV together; a tidy boarding party for anyone still treating patching as optional.

findings.title: FOUR MAXIMUM-SEVERITY FLAWS PATCHED
findings.comment: Four CVSS 10.0 holes hit NetWeaver, Web Dispatcher, Gateway and SAML authentication; the crown jewels have generously left the gangplank down.
